_comment: Starter decks. Six distinct cards each, per the reference-game analysis in CLAUDE.md section 17: six is the better mobile format, and it forces every deck to answer air rather than carrying a spare body. Every card named here must have a component behind it. Deck building by the player arrives in Phase 7.
_airComment: Every deck must contain at least one card whose targets include air, or a single flyer wins the match unopposed. Enforced by cards_test.dart.
